name: MQ-135 Air Quality Gas Sensor
description: Analog gas sensor for air quality monitoring. Detects NH3, NOx, alcohol, benzene, smoke, CO2. Outputs analog voltage proportional to gas concentration. Needs ADC to read.

calibration.warmup_time: 24-48 hours for first use, 2-5 minutes after
calibration.adc_to_ppm: Requires calibration curve. Raw ADC > 300 typically indicates poor air quality.
calibration.reference: Rs/R0 ratio vs ppm logarithmic curve per gas type

operations.name: read_air_quality
operations.desc: Read air quality sensor analog value via ADC
operations.returns: Raw ADC value (higher = more gas detected)

operations.name: read_air_digital
operations.desc: Read digital output (HIGH=clean, LOW=gas detected above threshold)

operations.name: monitor_air
operations.desc: Monitor air quality and trigger when value exceeds threshold
